title: Typography / Please don’t
slide_intent: Show typographic failure cases because brand voice can break through color, case and hierarchy even when the correct fonts are present.
strategic_value: Concrete prohibitions can help Duolingo keep its two-face system clear and recognizable.
demonstration: Six illustrated examples identify mixed-face sentences, multicolor Feather Bold, neutral display type, clipped text, incorrect case and headline/logo scale conflicts.
practical_value: Review a composition for these setting errors before release.

content_islands.name: Misuse specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack six crossed-out typography examples in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Prohibitions and exception
content_islands.spec: Place the matching prohibitions at right, retaining the one-color-printing exception for neutral display text.

reference_purposes.Application: The illustrated cases make common setting errors concrete.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source forbids the six shown treatments, while allowing neutral Feather Bold for one-color printing.

ingredient.name: Typographic integrity
ingredient.role: Preserve the distinction between headline voice, supporting copy and signature.
ingredient.application: Do not mix faces in one sentence, use multiple secondary colors within Feather Bold, run text off the display, use display-face sentence/title case or size a DIN headline equal to the logo.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical misuse guidance. Neutral Feather Bold is prohibited except in one-color printing; retain that exception.
